anchors: Both shoe soles fixed on floor
Stance width and toe angles fixed
camera: Front three-quarter facing left, full body portrait

frames.body: Upright, soft knees, both arms forward at shoulder height.
frames.label: STAND TALL

frames.body: Small hip/knee bend, heels down, arms remain forward.
frames.label: BEGIN DESCENT

frames.body: Hips lower and slightly back, knees track toes, thighs approaching parallel.
frames.label: LOWER

frames.body: Controlled depth around or below parallel with whole feet planted, neutral trunk.
frames.label: BOTTOM

frames.body: Reverse the middle squat pose, hips and chest rise together.
frames.label: DRIVE UP

frames.body: Near standing, same early-pose geometry, then closes loop at upright frame1.
frames.label: FINISH RISING

loop: 6 to1 completes controlled rise. No camera or stance changes.

muscles.stabilisers: Subtle pale trunk and adductor emphasis

variation: Bodyweight squat with both arms held forward for balance
Standing straight-bar shrug with double-overhand shoulder-width grip
camera: Front three-quarter facing left; full body portrait
equipment: Rigid straight bar, one identical modest plate each side

frames.label: START
frames.body: Stand tall, arms straight, shoulders at relaxed neutral.
frames.equipment: Bar rests at thighs in closed overhand grip.

frames.label: BEGIN SHRUG
frames.body: Shoulder girdle rises a small amount, head stays still.
frames.equipment: Whole bar rises with straight arms; no bar tilt.

frames.label: CONTINUE LIFT
frames.body: Shoulders rise farther vertically, no rolling.
frames.equipment: Bar and plates rise together, grip width unchanged.

frames.label: TOP
frames.body: Comfortable highest shoulder elevation with neutral neck.

frames.label: FINISH LOWERING
frames.equipment: Bar near thighs, then loop returns to start.

loop: Controlled descending frame6 to neutral frame1.
